text: Unit c9's lead bullets omit several notable behaviours in its lines: k_storage_readable is book.reclaimable_kv_restore_attempt_ == 0 && book.slot_base(storage_offset) != nullptr, because clear_kv_complete_at runs on both sides of a KV restore commit (2534-2542); the thread rule 'Called with the token tree locked, between forward passes: no reader runs meanwhile' (2550-2551); the loop breaks at the EAGLE entry when the book has no EAGLE storage and skips entries at or above logical_slot_count (2558-2560); blocks above the offset keep their bytes, only their bits are dropped (2549-2550); the drops are fetch_and with release order after acquire loads (2564-2568, 2583-2584).

fields.problem: Missing lead bullets for the readability predicate, the thread rule, the entry skip rules, the bytes-left-alone rule for blocks above, and the memory orders.
fields.proposed_fix: Replace the lead list with the one proposed.
proposed_lead_bullets: clear_kv_complete_at now also calls k_forget_row(offset) after zeroing the kv_saves_ counters of that offset (2472-2477).

k_forget_row drops, in every state entry, the row bits at and above the offset (mask rows_below) and the block bits of those blocks (mask blocks_below), with fetch_and in release order (2553-2555, 2583-2584). Blocks above the offset hold no live row: their bits are dropped and their bytes are left alone (2549-2550).

When the offset's block keeps rows below the offset (block_keeps_rows = offset % k_vnni::BLOCK_TOKENS_16 != 0, 2556), is converted, and the storage is readable, the block goes back to row-major first with block_to_rows for every KV head, so those rows stay readable (2571-2582).

k_storage_readable: the book's storage is published (book.reclaimable_kv_restore_attempt_ == 0) and the slot's arena is allocated (book.slot_base != nullptr); clear_kv_complete_at runs on both sides of a KV restore commit (full.hpp invalidate_restored_book), and then only the bits change (2534-2542).
Entries: the EAGLE entry (ix == layout_t::n_slots) ends the loop when the book has no EAGLE storage; entries at or above book.logical_slot_count() are skipped (2558-2560).
A decode append with nothing at or above the offset costs two acquire loads and no locked read-modify-write (2565-2570).
Thread rule (2550-2551): called with the token tree locked, between forward passes; no reader runs meanwhile.

note: All line facts verified in the head: clear_kv_complete_at 2472-2477 (k_forget_row call 2476); k_storage_readable 2534-2542 (predicate 2540-2541, restore-commit sentence 2536-2537; invalidate_restored_book exists at full.hpp:3329); thread rule 2550-2551; bytes-left-alone 2549-2550; masks 2553-2555; line 2556 reads 'block_keeps_rows = offset % k_vnni::BLOCK_TOKENS_16 != 0' (not '16'); break/continue 2558-2560; acquire loads 2564 and 2568; two-load fast path 2565-2570; block_to_rows loop 2571-2582; fetch_and release 2583-2584. Claim text stands; the third proposed bullet needed the verbatim identifier.

text: book: the unit of KV cache memory allocation, which reserves space for a requested number of pages and owns the actual memory (a page is a lightweight reference into it); it has n_slots logical slots (n_slots = kv_slot_specs.size()) and owns all DMA memory including the EAGLE embedding storage.

fields.definition: The struct that owns one KV cache allocation: it reserves space for a requested number of pages and owns the actual memory (a page is a lightweight reference into it). It has n_slots = kv_slot_specs.size() logical slots and owns all DMA memory including the EAGLE embedding storage. page objects belong to a book (the member `book`).

fields.definition: A block of 64 contiguous tokens of KV data (page_size). Attention proceeds page by page. The page struct keeps the per-token, per-slot save counters kv_saves_ and the new K layout bits.

text: minibatch and grain: a forward pass is cut into minibatches of tokens; a grain is a group of at most 8 speculated tokens (minibatch_grain_size) that is never split.

fields.definition: A forward pass processes its tokens in minibatches. A grain is a group of up to 8 speculated tokens (minibatch_grain_size) that is never split across minibatches. A 16-token block may therefore be split across two minibatches of one pass.

text: latch: a counting synchronisation object (latch_ref); upstream_kvs_ready is the per-slot consumer latch that counts the minibatches whose K/V are not yet saved; save_k_impl counts it down once per downstream minibatch after every row of the minibatch is stored and marked.

fields.definition: A countdown synchronisation object (latch_ref, threading.hpp). batch::upstream_kvs_ready is the per-slot latch the downstream attention waits on; save_k_impl and save_v_impl each count it down once per downstream minibatch after all their row stores and marks (model.hpp:3454-3456, 3529-3531).

text: TRON_K_VNNI: the CMake option (default OFF, requires TRON_AMX_DISPATCH) that makes k_vnni::layout_on<128> true, so the K plane of every 128-dimension head holds the VNNI layout.

text: qk_group: k_vnni::qk_group, the AVX-512 reader of a VNNI plane; it scores the tokens named by a 64-bit live mask against the kv_mul query heads of one group (any group size; more than 16 heads are scored 16 at a time, MAX_KV_MUL_16), one token per lane.
